# Judge Paws — The First AI Relationship Court

> Judge Paws (汪汪法官) is a bilingual (English/中文) entertainment web app where an AI
> judge — a very fluffy dog — settles relationship disputes. Users pick a relationship
> type (couple, situationship, ex, roommate, bestie, family group chat), tell their side
> by voice or text, optionally upload chat screenshots as evidence, and receive a funny
> but secretly fair verdict.

## What the verdict includes
- A punny ruling (e.g. "PAW-SITIVELY GUILTY") delivered by a jury of five opinionated dogs
- Judge's note that lands a fair point on BOTH parties
- Drama Meter (0–100), Relationship Credit Scores, a "Who Started It?" blame split
- Red flags & green flags extracted from the story and screenshots
- A ready-to-post caption and a one-tap tall share image (long-image format for social)

## Key facts
- Pricing: first verdict each day is free; sharing earns bonus verdicts; Judge Paws+ is
  $2.99/month for unlimited verdicts, Savage mode and appeals.
- Languages: fully bilingual English / 中文 — verdicts are written natively in either.
- Tech: verdicts are generated by Claude (Anthropic) with vision over uploaded screenshots;
  voice input uses on-device browser speech recognition.
- Privacy: uploaded screenshots are processed for a single verdict and not persisted.
- Not legal advice — entertainment only.
